csv_scope_of_work: The State of Montana, Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to Provide on call professional structural engineering services to support the Bridge Maintenance Section in administering the statewide bridge maintenance program and addressing structural and safety needs for bridges and other transportation structures. The consultant will help review inspection and load rating information, develop and recommend maintenance and repair strategies, assist with emergency and special assessments, and provide technical input on standards, procedures, and program documentation consistent with federal and state requirements and MDT practices.
